title: Should the feature blueprint fill fields on the feature instead of creating child tickets?
why: Applied to HEIST-1, behaviour and tests duplicated the description and acceptance fields; states is worded for UI.

decision.rationale: Owner on 2026-11-12: left the choice to the agent, with the guidance that meta information goes directly on the ticket, that tickets are created when a task really needs more tickets, and that this must not depend on the blueprint. Implemented as blueprint answer and attach.
